supersedes: direct rerun of terminal-boundary history interventions on uncalibrated rows

public_gates: M1544 must implement bounded calibration before interventions
M1544 must measure actual simulator decision/post-decision margins
M1544 must preserve P0 actor input contract
M1544 must keep materialization and training blocked

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: implements a bounded calibration smoke to test whether actual near-boundary terminal rows can be generated
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: infrastructure and bounded calibration smoke only; no candidate materialization, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if calibration would require actor-input changes
stop if calibration exports a training corpus or materializes candidates
stop after calibration smoke and route to audit
fallback_plan: route to audit after any completed calibration smoke
route to branch synthesis if near-boundary calibrated rows remain absent
route to calibrated intervention design only if source and near-boundary gates pass

admission_evidence: M1543 pre-registered calibration variables, windows, artifacts, and pass/fail thresholds
allowed_updates: M1544 status queue scoreboard research log and review
next_stage_criteria: actual decision/post-decision margin windows are reported
guardrails are clean or failures explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1544 only calibrates task sampling and must not claim history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: future calibrated wrong-history and donor-stream tests must be designed separately
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If calibrated near-boundary rows cannot be produced, record the blocker and audit before another narrow repair.
allowed_claims: no promotion, training corpus export, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A bounded calibration implementation can generate actual fixed-policy terminal target rows in decision/post-decision near-boundary windows without changing actor inputs or materializing candidates.
success_criteria: focused tests cover calibration grid guardrails and summary schema
candidate materialization training PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and training-corpus export remain blocked
failure_criteria: calibration module or smoke artifacts are missing
implementation changes actor inputs or uses private holdout
implementation materializes candidates exports a training corpus or starts training/PPO
decision_rule: M1544 passes if calibration artifacts are written and all no-materialization/no-training guardrails remain clean.
